title: WGS Germline Variant Calling — GATK4
description: Whole-genome germline variant calling following GATK4 Best Practices. Supports FASTQ input or direct SRA accession download. Steps: FastQC → fastp trimming → BWA-MEM2 alignment → MarkDuplicates → BQSR → HaplotypeCaller (gVCF) → GenotypeGVCFs → VariantFiltration → SnpEff annotation → MultiQC.

input_options.title: Input options
input_options.description: Define input reads. Provide either a FASTQ glob pattern (e.g. 's3://bucket/sample_R{1,2}.fastq.gz') or an SRA accession (SRR/ERR/DRR prefix).

reads.description: Paired FASTQ glob pattern (e.g. 'sample_R{1,2}.fastq.gz') OR SRA accession (e.g. SRR1518169). For SRA input, set max_spots to limit download size during testing.

max_spots.description: Limit number of SRA spots downloaded (0 = unlimited). Set to e.g. 100000 for quick test runs; leave 0 for full production analysis.

reference_options.title: Reference genome
reference_options.description: Reference FASTA and known-variant sites for BQSR. Either supply explicit file paths or use the 'genome' shorthand to auto-resolve BioMate's iGenomes S3 paths.

genome.description: Genome shorthand. BioMate resolves this to the matching reference FASTA + known-sites VCF from iGenomes S3. Use explicit 'reference' + 'known_sites' paths to override.

reference.description: Path to reference FASTA file (must be pre-indexed with BWA-MEM2 and samtools faidx). Overrides the 'genome' shorthand when provided.

known_sites.description: VCF of known germline variants for Base Quality Score Recalibration (BQSR). Typically dbSNP + Mills indels (e.g. s3://ngi-igenomes/igenomes/Homo_sapiens/GATK/GRCh38/dbsnp_146.hg38.vcf.gz).

dbsnp_vcf.description: Optional separate dbSNP VCF for variant annotation. If omitted, known_sites is reused for annotation.

caller_options.title: Variant caller
caller_options.description: Select and configure the germline variant caller.

caller.description: Variant caller to use. 'gatk' (GATK4 HaplotypeCaller, recommended) gives the best sensitivity/specificity for WGS. 'deepvariant' (Google) is a deep-learning caller with slightly higher SNP precision. 'freebayes' is a fast open-source Bayesian caller.

scatter_count.description: Number of genome intervals to scatter HaplotypeCaller across in parallel. Higher values speed up calling on multi-core instances (recommended: 8–32).

ploidy.description: Sample ploidy. 2 for diploid human/mouse. Use 1 for haploid organisms or sex chromosomes if running separately.

min_base_quality_score.description: Minimum base quality score for a base to be included in variant calling. GATK default is 10; 20 is recommended for stricter calls.

vqsr_mode.description: Use VQSR (Variant Quality Score Recalibration) instead of hard filters. Requires a large callset (≥30 samples or deep WGS). For single-sample or low-coverage data, leave false (hard-filter mode).

sample_options.title: Sample metadata
sample_options.description: Sample identity information written into the read group (@RG) header of the output BAM.

sample_id.description: Sample identifier written into BAM read group (SM tag) and used as prefix for output files.

platform.description: Sequencing platform written into BAM read group (PL tag). Used by GATK for platform-specific recalibration models.

library.description: Library name written into BAM read group (LB tag). Used to identify PCR duplicates across libraries for the same sample.

qc_thresholds.title: QC thresholds
qc_thresholds.description: Coverage and alignment QC gates. BioMate flags runs that fall below these thresholds in the triage panel.

min_mean_coverage.description: Minimum acceptable mean genome coverage (×). Runs below this are flagged as AMBER. GATK Best Practices recommend ≥30× for WGS; 20× is the minimum for reliable variant calling.

min_alignment_rate.description: Minimum acceptable alignment rate (%). Runs below this are flagged as AMBER. Values below 70% suggest contamination, wrong reference, or severe adapter issues.

outdir.description: Directory where pipeline results will be saved.
